subject.title: [Feature]: Non-interactive command to use Codex OAuth for model provider

question: Should OpenClaw add a non-interactive OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex OAuth setup path, and what callback or token handoff is acceptable?
rationale: This creates a public auth-provider contract around OAuth authorization material, environment/config behavior, and provider routing, so automation cannot choose the security posture safely.

options.title: Design Safer Auth Handoff
options.body: Add a provider-owned non-interactive flow that validates PKCE/state, minimizes callback URL exposure, redacts diagnostics, and documents the supported contract before implementation.

options.title: Accept Callback URL Env
options.body: Support an environment callback import only if maintainers explicitly accept the exposure model and require state validation, redaction, docs, and live security proof.

options.title: Defer To Existing Flows
options.body: Keep API-key, browser/manual paste, and device-code as the supported setup surfaces until upstream Codex exposes a safer stable contract.

recommendation.title: Design Safer Auth Handoff
recommendation.body: Add a provider-owned non-interactive flow that validates PKCE/state, minimizes callback URL exposure, redacts diagnostics, and documents the supported contract before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available owner from the non-interactive provider setup and OpenAI provider-auth history.
